notes.title: Announcement of the schedule for the next major update
notes.content:
The next major update is scheduled for,
“Early January 2025.”

The features and fixes planned for release are as follows at this time.
-Adding functions for purchasing and transferring cars
-Listen to music during driving
 (classical music, etc.)
-Expanded ability to adjust drawing process
-Collection elements (Discovery)
-Set WayPoint(destination), display distance and direction to WayPoint
-UI enhancement of in-drive screen (Guide View)
-Add manuals to the game.

(Other minor changes)
-Engine sound reproduction.
-Set a unique name for each type of car.
-Correction of some language settings that were not reflected correctly.
-Renewal of library images (library capsule)
-Improvement of My Home Selection screen.
-Improvement of Fast Travel screen.

(Development is in the final stages, but if problems are found before release, the release may be postponed or cancelled. We ask for your patience in that case.)
(We would also like to make updates in the future.
 These are additional features for the racing element and overall improvements for the 
 Early Access graduation.
 Development for the next release is well underway, but please bear in mind that not everything will 
 suddenly be better.
 We intend to improve it gradually in future updates. )

[Total number of units sold to date] (reference) (8/2 release date - as of 10/20)
14 units

Development work will continue regardless of the total number of units sold.

notes.title: v0.00.02 Bug fixes and other releases
notes.content:
Fixed a problem in which events could not be started by pressing the Enter key.
Fixed that the menu can be operated with the arrow keys on the keyboard.
Fixed that race events were not displayed in areas other than Nerima Ward.
Displayed the direction (north) on the mini-map while driving.
